summary.intent: Speed up and finish a batch of cleanup and follow-up work on the callisto repo: close stale trails, clean up merged worktrees, document the changeset process in AGENTS.md and the PR template, and fix duplicated discovery notes.
summary.outcome: Worktrees and 11 trails were cleaned up, docs PR #495 was opened, linked to trail 152 and given its description. The note-once fix (process-wide `note_once` guard) was reviewed, a changeset added, all five local checks passed, and it was committed and pushed on `fix/note-once`; the PR itself had not yet been opened.

repo: AGENTS.md and .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md carry the changeset process: one changeset per user-visible outcome, written in the PR that makes it visible; multi-PR features get one from the last PR; fixes to unreleased features, internal, test-only or docs-only changes get none.
Local verification is a set of five checks: just pre-push, lint, doc-check, test, workflow-contracts, run via a verify.sh script.

Discovery notes are emitted via eprintln!("note: ...") in callisto-graph walk.rs and locate/ignore_walk.rs; TAGS_UNBOUND_NOTE in callisto-cli release.rs is a separate release-preview note and was intentionally left alone.
native_resolution_e2e_tests (pnpm_and_uv workspace tests) need `uv lock` and network access, so they fail inside the sandbox but pass outside it.
The sandbox locks the shared .git/config, so `git switch -c <branch> origin/main` errors when writing upstream config; the branch is still created but has no upstream tracking.

code.finding: New pub(crate) note_once(message: String) -> bool uses OnceLock<Mutex<BTreeSet<String>>> to print each message to stderr once per process, recovering from a poisoned lock.
New test init_prints_the_ignored_private_root_note_once runs `callisto init --yes` and asserts the note appears exactly once on stderr; a mutation check showed 3 copies without the guard.

workflow: Entire blocks `entire trail comment` from Claude sessions because comments are for people; decisions were recorded in the trail descriptions instead of working around the block.
`entire trail comment add` needs `--trail <id>` and `--project`; guessing positional syntax failed.
Subagent reports were verified by re-running the checks outside the sandbox before committing, and a subagent's suggested Verify text was trimmed because it described a check that was not run.
Worktree cleanup removed only worktrees whose tip was in origin/main.

friction: User felt the assistant was slowing things down and asked for a faster pace.
Both trail comments failed first on a wrong syntax guess, then were blocked by Entire for Claude sessions.
Sandbox network and git config restrictions caused spurious test failures and a branch upstream error in the subagent run.
The subagent did not run the two failing e2e tests on a clean baseline, so it could not prove they fail independently of its change.
